contentEn:
Reno Stars has completed full-home renovations across Burnaby in 2025 and 2026, from Metrotown condos to east Burnaby detached houses. Based on those real projects, a complete whole-house renovation in Burnaby costs $150,000–$650,000+ in 2026, depending on size and scope. Here is the full breakdown.

How Much Does a Whole House Renovation Cost in Burnaby? The Short Answer

A whole-house renovation in Burnaby, BC costs $150,000–$650,000+ in 2026. Smaller condo whole-home remodels start around $150,000–$250,000. Larger detached houses with structural changes and full mechanical updates typically run $350,000–$650,000 or more. Every price on this page comes from Burnaby-area projects Reno Stars completed in 2025–2026.

What Drives Cost Up in a Burnaby Whole-House Renovation?

Three factors push Burnaby whole-house costs above comparable projects in neighbouring cities:

  • Strata approvals: Burnaby has a high concentration of townhouse and condo complexes managed by strata councils. Each structural or common-element change requires strata approval, adding 4–12 weeks and $2,000–$8,000 in administrative and consultant costs. Reno Stars manages the full strata submission process as part of the project.
  • Age of housing stock: Many Burnaby homes — particularly in East Hastings, Burnaby Heights, and Metrotown — were built 1960–1985. These homes often need full electrical panel upgrades (100A to 200A, $4,000–$9,000), re-piping ($6,000–$15,000), and asbestos remediation ($3,000–$12,000 in pre-1990 homes) before cosmetic work can begin.
  • Permit requirements: Burnaby's building department requires permits for any structural change, bathroom addition, or kitchen layout modification in detached houses. Permit costs in Burnaby run $3,500–$12,000 for a whole-house project, depending on scope.

How Long Does a Whole House Renovation Take in Burnaby?

A whole-house renovation in Burnaby takes 4–10 months from permit submission to final handover. Condo and townhouse projects run 4–7 months (strata approval adds 1–3 months). Detached house projects run 6–10 months (permits, structural work, and older-home remediation extend the timeline). Reno Stars provides a detailed project schedule at the quote stage so you know exactly what happens each week.

Burnaby Neighbourhoods and Cost Variations

Renovation cost varies by Burnaby neighbourhood due to housing type, age, and accessibility:

  • Metrotown / Central Burnaby: Mostly high-rise condos and townhouses. Whole-unit remodels are common. Condo strata rules govern all work. Projects here typically run $150,000–$380,000 for a full unit.
  • Burnaby Heights / North Burnaby: Mix of 1960s–1980s houses and small apartment blocks. Pre-1990 homes frequently need asbestos assessments. Detached house projects typically $350,000–$600,000.
  • East Burnaby / Edmonds: More single-family homes, often on larger lots. More structural and exterior work. Typical detached-house projects run $380,000–$650,000+.
  • Brentwood / Gilmore: Rapidly redeveloping area with newer construction and newer condos. Strata complexity is lower; project timelines are shorter. Whole-unit remodels typically $150,000–$320,000.

Frequently Asked Questions About Whole House Renovations in Burnaby

Do I need a permit for a whole-house renovation in Burnaby?

Yes, for any structural change, bathroom addition, or kitchen reconfiguration in a detached house in Burnaby. Condo and townhouse work also requires strata approval before permits can be applied for. Reno Stars handles both the strata submission and the municipal permit application as part of the project management fee.

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Burnaby specifically?

A full kitchen gut renovation in Burnaby costs $55,000–$75,000 on average in 2026, based on Reno Stars' completed projects. High-end finishes (custom cabinetry, professional-grade appliances, stone countertops) push costs to $90,000 or more. Basic kitchen refreshes (cabinet refacing, new countertops, updated lighting) run $25,000–$40,000.

What is the biggest cost surprise in Burnaby whole-house renovations?

Electrical panel upgrades are the most common surprise. Many Burnaby homes built before 1985 still have 100-amp panels. A 100A-to-200A upgrade is required before adding modern appliances, electric vehicle chargers, or expanded lighting — costing $4,000–$9,000 and often adding 2–3 weeks to the schedule. Reno Stars includes a pre-construction electrical assessment in every whole-house quote.

Does Burnaby's strata approval process add significant time?

Yes. For strata-titled properties (condos and townhouses), strata approval typically adds 4–12 weeks to a project timeline. The process requires detailed drawings, contractor insurance certificates, and sometimes a formal residents' meeting vote. Reno Stars has completed dozens of strata-approved renovations in Burnaby's condo and townhouse complexes and manages the entire process for homeowners.

Are renovation costs higher in Burnaby than other Metro Vancouver cities?

Burnaby's costs are comparable to Vancouver and North Vancouver, and slightly below West Vancouver for equivalent scope. They run 5–10% higher than Surrey or Delta for comparable project types, primarily due to permit and strata complexity. The cost premium is offset by Burnaby's strong resale market — a well-renovated Burnaby home commands a significant premium at sale.

本拿比整屋装修要多少钱？简短回答

本拿比整屋装修费用为 15万至65万加元以上。小型公寓全屋翻新起价约15至25万加元。较大独立屋含结构改动和全屋机电更新的装修通常在35至65万加元或以上。本页面所有价格均来自聚星装修2025至2026年在本拿比地区完成的项目。

哪些因素推高本拿比全屋装修成本？

三个主要因素使本拿比全屋装修成本高于邻近城市同类项目：

  • 物业管理审批：本拿比有大量联排别墅和公寓，由业主立案法团（strata council）管理。每个结构性改动或公共区域变更均需 strata 审批，增加4至12周时间和$2,000至$8,000的行政及顾问费用。聚星装修代为处理完整 strata 提交流程。
  • 房屋年龄：本拿比许多住宅（尤其是东黑斯廷斯、本拿比高地和铁道镇）建于1960至1985年。这些房屋通常需要全部电路板升级（100A至200A，$4,000至$9,000）、水管更换（$6,000至$15,000）以及石棉处理（1990年前房屋，$3,000至$12,000），之后才能开始表面装修工程。
  • 许可证要求：本拿比建筑部门要求对任何结构性改动、新增卫生间或厨房布局调整申请许可证。独立屋全屋装修许可证费用为$3,500至$12,000，视乎工程范围而定。

本拿比全屋装修需要多长时间？

本拿比全屋装修从申请许可证到最终交付需要 4至10个月。公寓和联排别墅项目需4至7个月（strata 审批额外增加1至3个月）。独立屋项目需6至10个月（许可证、结构工程和老房修复延长工期）。聚星装修在报价阶段提供详细工程进度表，让业主清楚了解每周施工安排。

本拿比各社区装修费用差异

装修费用因本拿比各社区的房屋类型、年龄和交通可达性不同而有所差异：

  • 铁道镇/本拿比市中心：主要是高层公寓和联排别墅。全屋翻新项目常见。公寓 strata 规定约束所有工程。此类项目通常费用为$150,000至$380,000。
  • 本拿比高地/北本拿比：1960至80年代独立屋和小型公寓混合区。1990年前建成的房屋常需石棉检测。独立屋项目通常$350,000至$600,000。
  • 东本拿比/埃德蒙兹：更多独立屋，地块较大。结构和外观工程较多。独立屋项目通常$380,000至$650,000+。
  • 布伦特伍德/吉尔莫：正在快速发展的地区，较新建筑和公寓。Strata 复杂性较低，工期较短。全屋翻新项目通常$150,000至$320,000。

本拿比全屋装修常见问题

本拿比全屋装修需要申请许可证吗？

需要。独立屋的任何结构性改动、新增卫生间或厨房布局调整均需申请许可证。公寓和联排别墅在申请许可证前也需获得 strata 批准。聚星装修代为处理 strata 提交和市府许可证申请，作为工程管理费的一部分。

本拿比厨房装修具体要多少钱？

本拿比全套厨房拆改装修在2026年平均费用为$55,000至$75,000（基于聚星装修已完成项目）。高端装修（定制橱柜、专业级电器、石材台面）费用达$90,000或以上。基础厨房翻新（橱柜贴面、新台面、更新照明）费用为$25,000至$40,000。

本拿比全屋装修最大的费用意外是什么？

电路板升级是最常见的意外费用。许多1985年前建造的本拿比房屋仍使用100安培电箱。在添加现代电器、电动汽车充电器或扩展照明之前，需要将电箱从100A升级至200A，费用$4,000至$9,000，通常还使工期延长2至3周。聚星装修在每次全屋报价中均包含施工前电路评估。

本拿比 strata 审批流程是否显著延长工期？

是的。对于分层产权物业（公寓和联排别墅），strata 审批通常使项目工期增加4至12周。该流程需要详细图纸、承包商保险证书，有时还需正式居民投票。聚星装修在本拿比多个公寓和联排别墅项目已完成大量 strata 审批工程，代业主管理整个流程。

本拿比装修费用比其他大温城市高吗？

本拿比装修费用与温哥华和北温哥华相当，对于同等工程范围略低于西温哥华。比素里或三角洲同类项目高5至10%，主要是许可证和 strata 复杂性导致。成本溢价由本拿比强劲的转售市场抵消——精心装修的本拿比房屋在出售时能获得可观的溢价。
